name: Tablo - Smart Tables for Real Data
description: Tablo turns any raw data into a styled, production-ready table in Figma - in one paste. No column setup. No manual styling. No Lorem Ipsum. Paste anything: CSV, TSV, Excel, markdown, tab-separated, multi-space - Tablo detects the format automatically. Copy from a spreadsheet, a terminal, Notion, or anywhere. It just works.
author: Monfort N. Brian <monfortbrian@outlook.com> (https://github.com/monfortbrian)
